=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh:185-195 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The new logic logs `outcome=deferred reason=cancelled_jobs_rerun` but does not exit the function or stop the execution flow.
  WHY: The reviewer says `review_final_ci_failed_main` keeps running after the log and still dispatches the hand-back, which breaks G4; it rated this MAJOR, while minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 say the block returns 0 at line 193 before the dispatch.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:1946-1948 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new final_ci_now_green skip branch runs after the catch-all AUTOFIX_GATE_SKIP line at 1747-1748, and it neither logs AUTOFIX_GATE_SKIP itself nor sets GATE_SKIP_RECORDED="true".
  WHY: These runs log no AUTOFIX_GATE_SKIP line, so log analysis keyed on that registered stable prefix misses them; gate behaviour is not affected, and all reviewers rated it NIT.
- README.md:176 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The FINAL_CI_FAILED_REDISPATCH_ENABLED row describes the abandoned-job deferral as unconditional, but review_final_ci_failed_infra_verdict only returns a verdict on shubhodeep1/coding-workflows, with FINAL_CI_FAILED_INFRA_RERUN_ENABLED on, CI_CANCELLED_AUTO_RERUN_ENABLED true and FINAL_CI_FAILED_RUN_ATTEMPT 1.
  WHY: In consumer repos, or with either switch off, these failures are still handed back and `outcome=deferred reason=cancelled_jobs_rerun` is never logged, so operators would misread the logs; all reviewers rated it NIT (confidence 3-4), and minimax_minimax-m3 filed it under TASK COMPLETENESS.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:1935-1937 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The hard-coded 4-token string `${final_ci_head_gate:-unreadable - none -}` doubles as the read's default on a failed statuses read, which is fragile if the jq output ever gains a field.
  WHY: The reviewer says this is not a runtime defect (it takes the intended fail-open path to the full review) and rated it NIT.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:1937 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The strict regex `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z$` on the status `created_at` would reject fractional seconds or a `+00:00` offset and reset final_ci_status_at to "".
  WHY: The reviewer says it falls through to the existing repair path (fail-safe), notes that GitHub returns the matched format today, and rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "G4. The hand-back and the cancelled-job re-run do not both act on one failed attempt." (the hand-back logs the `deferred` status for cancelled jobs and does not dispatch)
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh (review_final_ci_failed_main)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The code logs the deferral reason but does not `return 0` or otherwise end the function, so the dispatch logic after it can still run for that PR. (minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 dispute this: they cite `return 0` at scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh:193.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:lines 1946-1948, the new final_ci_now_green branch (SHOULD_RUN="false"; SKIP_REASON="final_ci_now_green"; echo "FINAL_CI_REPAIR ... outcome=skipped reason=final_ci_now_green"). Compare lines 1745-1749 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new skip is set inside the Final-CI repair block (which starts at line 1844), after the catch-all AUTOFIX_GATE_SKIP line at 1747-1748 has already run, and it neither logs AUTOFIX_GATE_SKIP nor sets GATE_SKIP_RECORDED. Every other skip either reaches line 1748 or logs inline (312, 611, 883).
  WHY: These runs log no AUTOFIX_GATE_SKIP line (a registered stable prefix: agents.md line 4272, LOG_PREFIX.name=AUTOFIX_GATE_SKIP at line 4733), so log analysis misses them; gate behaviour is not affected. Fix: add GATE_SKIP_RECORDED="true" and echo "AUTOFIX_GATE_SKIP reason=final_ci_now_green pr=${PR_NUMBER} head_sha=${pr_head_sha_gate}".
- README.md:line 176, the FINAL_CI_FAILED_REDISPATCH_ENABLED row | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The row describes the abandoned-job deferral as unconditional, but review_final_ci_failed_infra_verdict (scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh lines 94-99) returns a verdict only for shubhodeep1/coding-workflows, with CI_CANCELLED_AUTO_RERUN_ENABLED true, FINAL_CI_FAILED_RUN_ATTEMPT 1 and FINAL_CI_FAILED_INFRA_RERUN_ENABLED on (lines 83-91). The row has no "coding-workflows only" note.
  WHY: Consumer repos still hand back every abandoned-only failure and never log outcome=deferred reason=cancelled_jobs_rerun, so operators would misread the logs. Fix: add "(coding-workflows only, and only while FINAL_CI_FAILED_INFRA_RERUN_ENABLED is on)".
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. G1/G2 are delivered at evaluate_gate.sh lines 1938-1948, G3 at review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh lines 1327-1342, and G4 by the return 0 at scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh line 193. The reviewer says the pass-1 G4 TASK_GAP is wrong.
- Hardening: add the AUTOFIX_GATE_SKIP line and GATE_SKIP_RECORDED at lines 1946-1948 (2 lines); HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:lines 1935-1937 (the `${final_ci_head_gate:-unreadable - none -}` default for a failed read) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: On a failed statuses read, the 4-token default splits into state="unreadable"; the else branch logs "head_gate_not_success state=unreadable" and the green-skip is bypassed. The hard-coded string also serves as the read's default.
  WHY: It does not fail; this is the intended fail-open path (covered by test_gate_final_ci_repair_still_selected_when_final_ci_is_not_newer_green). It is fragile only if the jq output gains a field.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:line 1937 (regex `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z$`) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Fractional seconds or a `+00:00` offset would fail the regex and reset `final_ci_status_at` to "", which blocks the green skip.
  WHY: It does not fail; it falls through to the existing repair path (fail-safe), and GitHub returns the matched format today.
- README.md:line 176 (the FINAL_CI_FAILED_REDISPATCH_ENABLED row) [filed under TASK COMPLETENESS] | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The row applies to every consumer, but the deferral only fires on `shubhodeep1/coding-workflows`: `review_final_ci_failed_infra_verdict` (scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh:80-106) also requires FINAL_CI_FAILED_INFRA_RERUN_ENABLED on, CI_CANCELLED_AUTO_RERUN_ENABLED true and FINAL_CI_FAILED_RUN_ATTEMPT 1.
  WHY: Runtime is unchanged, but the docs mislead consumer operators; the line 177 row carries "(coding-workflows only)" and this paragraph needs the same note.
- Notes: the reviewer says the gemini G4 TASK_GAP is incorrect, because scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh:184-194 returns 0 before the marker POST / dispatch at lines 196-231. It confirms the sonnet AUTOFIX_GATE_SKIP observation (lines 1747-1748 vs 1946-1948) as real but observability-only (NIT), and found no new runtime defect.
- Hardening (2 related items): add GATE_SKIP_RECORDED and the AUTOFIX_GATE_SKIP echo after line 1948 (2 lines, risk 1); add "(coding-workflows only, see FINAL_CI_FAILED_INFRA_RERUN_ENABLED)" to README.md line 176 (1 line, risk 1).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
